mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (measured as the change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which drives positive equity returns through higher corporate earnings expectations; the joint behavior of these two series is necessary to capture the full strength of the demand surge.
failure_condition: The correlation between the joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) and positive 20d returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining UNRATE within the high-unemployment regime are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600.0 (thousands of units), it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1600.0) despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) determines the real interest rate; when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls (indicating a decline in real rates), it signals an accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity returns, and the interaction of these two series is necessary to capture the real rate effect.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS up and CPIAUCSL down) does not produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annually), a decline in GDP growth signals an impending slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining GDP growth within the late-cycle expansion regime are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
